description:
Tailscale is a WireGuard based mesh VPN, used to connect your computers and other devices together securely without proxies.


All Platforms
- Fixed: Connectivity stalls affecting Tailscale SSH, Tailscale Serve, and tsnet on lossy networks are resolved.
- Fixed: Tailscale SSH sessions no longer disconnect when a check mode approval expires.
- Fixed: An issue that could cause Tailscale SSH restarts to hang or background tasks to terminate is resolved.
Windows
- Fixed: An issue in the Windows .exe installer that could lead to privilege escalation at install time has been resolved. Existing installations do not need to be reinstalled.
macOS
- Fixed: Connection reliability is improved when the network reports an unreachable destination.
iOS
- Fixed: Connection reliability is improved when the network reports an unreachable destination.
tvOS
- Fixed: Connection reliability is improved when the network reports an unreachable destination.
